City of the Hunters, located in the [[Jinsinlis Legionate]]. Many rangers and archers train in the forests and undead wastes to the east, using the city to restock. Each house has the trophy of an evil creature mounted to the front of the house, with the bigger and more dangerous the better. The chief's house used to have a dragon's head mounted on it, but this was recently stolen, apparently by a demon.
